q: “Marketers have a number of major platforms to choose from and they would tend to gravitate to those that don't tell you to f-off,” said Jonathan Miller, chief executive of Integrated Media, which specialises in digital media investments.

2023 December 2, Hannah Murphy, Daniel Thomas, quoting Jonathan Miller, “X shifts ads strategy after Musk outburst over alleged blackmail”, in FT Weekend (Companies & Markets section), London: The Fin
